prompt: In the standard Solr synonyms.txt format (consumed by SynonymGraphFilterFactory), what character separates equivalent terms on a single rule line? One character.
notes: Comma — e.g., 'ferrari, ferr, prancing horse'. Not semicolon.

prompt: Write a synonyms.txt rule that makes 'tire', 'tyre', and 'wheel' all equivalent two-way synonyms. One line.
notes: tire, tyre, wheel — comma-separated; no => arrow for two-way

prompt: What syntax do I use in synonyms.txt to make a one-way rule where 'teh' should be replaced by 'the' (and 'teh' itself dropped from the token stream)?
notes: teh => the — left-hand side replaced by right-hand side; LHS dropped unless re-listed on RHS

prompt: I want 'vw' to expand to BOTH 'vw' and 'volkswagen' (so docs with 'vw' AND docs with 'volkswagen' both match). Show two valid synonyms.txt rules that achieve this — one with =>, one without.
notes: Two-way 'vw, volkswagen' OR explicit 'vw => vw, volkswagen' — including LHS on RHS keeps it

prompt: What is the modern Solr 9.x filter class name for synonym handling (the one that supports multi-word synonyms correctly via graph token streams)?
If I use SynonymGraphFilterFactory in an INDEX-time analyzer, what additional filter must I add after it to make the index work correctly? Just the class name.
notes: solr.FlattenGraphFilterFactory required AFTER SynonymGraphFilter on index analyzer (not query analyzer)

prompt: What character starts a comment line in synonyms.txt?
notes: # starts comments; blank lines also ignored

prompt: Can a single rule in synonyms.txt contain multi-word phrases like 'ear pads' as one entry? One word answer.
notes: Yes — multi-word entries (with spaces) work; e.g., 'ear pads, ear cushions, ear pad set' is valid

prompt: When should I NOT put a synonym pair in synonyms.txt and instead model it as concept docs in the concept collection? One sentence.
notes: Domain-specific equivalences (only-applies-to-headphones, only-applies-to-speakers) should be concept docs scoped via fq, not global synonyms.txt
